title: Harden a customer webhook integration
rubric: Verifies the HMAC over the raw request body, not over re-serialised JSON
Compares signatures in constant time (crypto.timingSafeEqual) and handles a signature of the wrong length or format without throwing
Rejects requests whose timestamp is missing, malformed or outside the five-minute window, and includes the timestamp in what is signed as the brief specifies
Duplicate deliveries of the same eventId are applied once and still answered 200, so the customer's retries stop
An older version never overwrites a newer one; the candidate decided and can justify what status an out-of-order event gets
Noticed that malformed JSON currently crashes the handler and that the secret must not be logged
Added tests for the cases the brief names but the provided tests do not cover: stale timestamp, out-of-order version, malformed signature
Scoped the work like an integration engineer: asked what the customer needs first, verified the agent's crypto code rather than trusting it, and can explain each check
